paragraphs.text: ATCO Pipelines is the only pipeline company that the City of Edmonton's Utility Line Assignment (ULA) application administrator circulates applications to. Other pipeline companies are not made aware of a project unless the designer applies to them directly for a high pressure pipeline crossing and/or proximity agreement.

Circulation of a ULA application is limited to ATCO Pipelines: the City of Edmonton ULA application administrator sends the application only to that company. Other pipeline companies will not be aware of a project unless the designer applies directly to them for a high pressure pipeline crossing and/or proximity agreement.
